name: 1CM Inc.
summary: 1CM Inc., a multi-jurisdictional cannabis company, retails cannabis, alcohol, tobacco, nicotine, and consumer packaged goods in Canada. The company operates cannabis and liquor retail stores. It also offers One Cannabis Market, a technology platform that provides B2B and B2C solutions, including last mile delivery, digital signage, big data analytics, and wholesale clearing services. The company was formerly known as Leviathan Natural Products Inc. and changed its name to 1CM Inc. in September 2022. 1CM Inc. is based in Markham, Canada.
